name: zgeometry_clip_patch_output_apply_node_di_pairs
description: zGeometry_ClipPatchOutput::ApplyNodeDiPairs applies each partition's node/display-instance pairs, frees replaced display instances, increments the feature-grid cell feature count, and clears the consumed pair array.
known_limits: Binary Ninja still renders the partition loop as byte-offset arithmetic over the partition array; the applied structure layout and assembly comments map those offsets to zGeometry_ClipPatchPartitionOutput fields. tier S verification is deferred to the coherent zDEClient/zGeometry clip-patch source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x46ae40 validates iterating each partition and node/DI pair, reading the old node user data, setting the new display instance, freeing a non-null old display instance through zModel_DiPool::FreeIfUnreferenced, incrementing featureGridCell->featureCount, freeing nodeDiPairs, clearing nodeDiPairs, clearing nodeDiPairCount, and returning zero.
The native zGeometry clip-patch output smoke verifies display-instance replacement/refcount, old DI return to the free list, feature count increment, pair-array free side effects, and zero return.
